episodes.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((key-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                       (let ((v (third p))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 8))))
                                     (grid-cells g)))
                  (kr1 (min-of first key-cells))
                  (kr2 (max-of first key-cells))
                  (kc1 (min-of second key-cells))
                  (kc2 (max-of second key-cells))
                  (kh (+ 1 (- kr2 kr1)))
                  (kw (+ 1 (- kc2 kc1)))
                  (eight-cells (find-color g 8))
                  (er1 (min-of first eight-cells))
                  (er2 (max-of first eight-cells))
                  (ec1 (min-of second eight-cells))
                  (ec2 (max-of second eight-cells))
                  (tile-h (/ (+ 1 (- er2 er1)) kh))
                  (tile-w (/ (+ 1 (- ec2 ec1)) kw)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((v v))
                        (if (= v 8)
                            (let* ((tr (/ (- r er1) tile-h))
                                   (tc (/ (- c ec1) tile-w))
                                   (kr (- (- kh 1) tc))
                                   (kc tr)
                                   (color (at g (+ kr1 kr) (+ kc1 kc))))
                              (if (zero? color) 0 color))
                            v)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((key-cells (filter (lambda (p)
                                       (let ((v (third p))) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 8))))
                                     (grid-cells g)))
                  (kr1 (min-of first key-cells))
                  (kr2 (max-of first key-cells))
                  (kc1 (min-of second key-cells))
                  (kc2 (max-of second key-cells))
                  (kh (+ 1 (- kr2 kr1)))
                  (kw (+ 1 (- kc2 kc1)))
                  (colors (remove-duplicates (map third key-cells)))
                  (anchor-color
                   (first
                    (filter (lambda (color)
                              (= 1 (count-if (lambda (p) (= (third p) color))
                                             key-cells)))
                            colors)))
                  (anchor-cell
                   (first (filter (lambda (p) (= (third p) anchor-color))
                                  key-cells)))
                  (anchor-row (- (first anchor-cell) kr1))
                  (clockwise? (< (* 2 anchor-row) kh))
                  (eight-cells (find-color g 8))
                  (er1 (min-of first eight-cells))
                  (er2 (max-of first eight-cells))
                  (ec1 (min-of second eight-cells))
                  (ec2 (max-of second eight-cells))
                  (tile-h (/ (+ 1 (- er2 er1)) kh))
                  (tile-w (/ (+ 1 (- ec2 ec1)) kw)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (let ((v v))
                        (if (= v 8)
                            (let* ((tr (/ (- r er1) tile-h))
                                   (tc (/ (- c ec1) tile-w))
                                   (kr (if clockwise?
                                           (- (- kh 1) tc)
                                           tc))
                                   (kc (if clockwise?
                                           tr
                                           (- (- kw 1) tr)))
                                   (color (at g (+ kr1 kr) (+ kc1 kc))))
                              (if (zero? color) 0 color))
                            v)))))))
